label: Bringing actual good from evils…: DrawsGoodFromEvils g evils y p means g actually brings the good…
term: bringing actual good from evils collectively
definition: DrawsGoodFromEvils g evils y p means g actually brings the good of perfection p in bearer y from the evils picked out by evils considered together. GoodIn y p records that actual good. The relation supplies no attribution to each member of the collection and no comparison of quantities of good and evil.
note: Parameter semantics for explicit scope comparison, motivated by the pinned ad 1 wording. A source argument fixing the relation extension or connecting the collective and distributive relations would be needed to go beyond this interpretation; no such bridge is supplied here. The linked Lean declaration is the conditional production schema that takes DrawsGoodFromEvils and GoodIn as independent parameters, not a definition of either relation. It requires a God, permission and a nonempty evil collection before its existential consequent; this locator does not assert any actual permission or good outcome.
